visualCharacteristics: Full-width embedded Google map with attribution; a button swaps it for an offices list with region filter, country headings with office counts and expandable city accordions showing address, phone, route link and photo.
contentPattern: Rows classified by content: a Google Maps link row, a filter-label text row, one row per office (h3 country | label | city | address/phone/route-link paragraphs | optional photo), then a button-label text row.
usage: Use to show an interactive office map with a toggleable, country-grouped list of office locations.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any location finder by adding one row per office and keeping the map-link, filter and button rows.
